acceptanceCriteria.text: AC1: True cross-event synergy (no false 6x equip item synergy; overlapCount counts distinct events)
AC2: Daily availability detection for Tower, Arena, Grand Arena, Expedition, Daily Quests, Daily Sign In, Guild War, and Dungeon
AC3: Actionable-first sorting, dedicated #goals-unavailable-section at bottom of GoalsTab.vue, accurate KPIs, and 100% English .vue text
AC4: Unit tests in tests/popup-data.test.mjs & tests/wxt-vue-frontend.test.mjs, npm test 0 fail, npm run build green

checkpointPayload.description: Separate completed/unavailable daily goals into a bottom section, fix false same-event equip/gather synergy, and detect daily exhaustion for Tower, Arena, Grand Arena, Expedition, Daily Quests, Daily Sign In, Guild War, and Dungeon.
checkpointPayload.title: P2-23 Goals Tab Actionability & True Cross-Event Synergy
